```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(qqman)
library(data.table)
```

## Clump pQTLs from the subcohorts to identify independent SNPs for comparison
``` {r plot_pve_tree_obclinic}
population_SNPs <- read_delim('results/1_population/CLUMPED_ONLY.nobmi.assoc.genome_wide.0.01.summary.cis_trans', col_names=TRUE, delim="\t", show_col_types = FALSE) 
obclinic_SNPs <- read_delim('results/2_obesity_clinic/CLUMPED_ONLY.nobmi.assoc.genome_wide.0.01.summary.cis_trans', col_names=TRUE, delim="\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

## Compare genome-wide hits
merged <- dplyr::full_join(population_SNPs, obclinic_SNPs, by = join_by("CHROM:POS:REF:ALT", "protein_name"), suffix = c("_pop", "_ob"))
perfect_matches <- dplyr::filter(merged, rs_ob == rs_pop)
pop_only <- dplyr::filter(merged, is.na(rs_ob))
ob_only <- dplyr::filter(merged, is.na(rs_pop))

print(paste0("There are ", nrow(merged), " total SNPs"))
print(paste0("There are ", nrow(perfect_matches), " perfect matches"))
print(paste0("There are ", nrow(pop_only), " gw in pop only"))
print(paste0("There are ", nrow(ob_only), " gw in ob only"))

## Find all pQTL per protein across both cohorts
both_cohorts <- bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(population_SNPs, cohort = "population"),
  dplyr::mutate(obclinic_SNPs, cohort = "obesity clinic"),
  ) %>%
  group_by(protein_name, `CHROM:POS:REF:ALT`) %>%
  # remove exact duplicates
  slice_min(order_by = p_wald, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Only retain lowest p value in MHC region (3 SNPs)
  group_by(protein_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    chr != 6 | pos < 29691116 | pos > 33054976 |
      p_wald == (
        if (any(chr == 6 & pos >= 29691116 & pos <= 33054976)) {
          min(p_wald[chr == 6 & pos >= 29691116 & pos <= 33054976], na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


## Clumping
clumping_results <- ld_clump(
    dplyr::tibble(rsid = both_cohorts[["CHROM:POS:REF:ALT"]], pval = both_cohorts$p_wald, id = both_cohorts$protein_name),
    plink_bin = genetics.binaRies::get_plink_binary(),
    bfile = "/autosomes",
    clump_kb = 500,
    clump_r2 = 0.01,
    clump_p = 0.99
)

post_clumping_pqtls <- dplyr::left_join(
  dplyr::select(clumping_results, rsid, id),
  both_cohorts,
  by = join_by("rsid" =="CHROM:POS:REF:ALT", "id" == "protein_name")
) %>%
  dplyr::rename("CHROM:POS:REF:ALT" = rsid, "protein_name" = id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(protein_name, "_inf"))

write_csv(post_clumping_pqtls, '3_obclinic_comparison/cis_trans_gw.csv')
```

## Load relevant pQTLs and their heterogeneity values
``` {r get_pQTL_chromosome}
obesity_clinic <- read_tsv("results/2_obesity_clinic/summary.cis_trans_gw")
population <- read_tsv("results/1_population/summary.cis_trans_gw")
comparison <- full_join(population, obesity_clinic, by=join_by("CHROM:POS:REF:ALT", "protein_name", "ps", "chr", "allele1", "allele0", "rs"), suffix = c("_population","_obclinic")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(is.na(af_population)|is.na(af_obclinic)))

## Add heterogeneity p-values
metal_population_obclinic <- readr::read_tsv('results/3_meta_analysis/summary.meta.stderr.cis_trans_gw.p_val', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% dplyr::mutate(HetPVal_category = case_when(
  p_fdr_heterogeneity < 0.05 ~ 'fdr p < 0.05',
  HetPVal < 0.05 ~ 'nominal p < 0.05',
  .default = 'not significant')) 

## Add FDR and cis_trans column
tss <- read_tsv("data/olink_TSS.extended.txt")

comparison_het <- dplyr::inner_join(comparison, metal_population_obclinic %>% dplyr::select(MarkerName, protein_name, HetPVal, p_fdr_heterogeneity, HetPVal_category), by = join_by(`CHROM:POS:REF:ALT` == MarkerName, protein_name == protein_name)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(., tss, by=join_by("protein_name"=="holbaek_id")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(c(ps, tss_hg19), as.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(c(chr, chr_tss_hg19), as.character)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cis_trans = case_when(
        (chr == chr_tss_hg19 & ps > tss_hg19 - 1000000 & ps < tss_hg19 + 1000000) ~ 'cis',
         TRUE ~ 'trans')) %>%
  ## Correct allele direction
  dplyr::rename(
    effect_allele = allele1,
    other_allele = allele0,
  ) 

## Write out dataframe 
write_csv(comparison_het, "3_obclinic_comparison/obesity_dependent_comparison.csv")
```

## Plot forest plots of heterogeneous SNP
```{r find_snps_subcohorts}
color_population <-'#006572'
color_obclinic <- '#fbab19'

legend_point_size <- 0.8
point_size <- 2.4
study_border_size <- 3.1

se_mult <- 1.96
comparison_het <- comparison_het %>% dplyr::filter(!grepl('_inf', protein_name)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_label = case_when(
    cis_trans == "cis" ~ paste0("*", protein_name, " (", rs, ")"),
    cis_trans == "trans" ~ paste0(protein_name, " (", rs, ")")
    )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gw_population = p_wald_population < 5e-8)  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gw_obclinic = p_wald_obclinic < 5e-8)
  
folder <- '3_obclinic_comparison/'

## Forest_plot obesity-dependent pQTLs
comparison_het_plot <- comparison_het %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !grepl("_inf", protein_name),
    HetPVal_category == "fdr p < 0.05"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_label = paste0(protein_name, " (", rs, ")"),
    gw_population = p_wald_population < 5e-8,
    gw_obclinic = p_wald_obclinic < 5e-8,
    sw_population = p_wald_population < 5e-8 / 177,
    sw_obclinic = p_wald_obclinic < 5e-8 / 177,
    pqtl_sig_population = dplyr::case_when(
      p_wald_population < 5e-8 / 177 ~ "P < 2.8e-10: study-wide",
      p_wald_population < 5e-8 ~ "P < 5e-8: genome-wide",
      TRUE ~ "P >= 5e-8: not significant"
    ),
    pqtl_sig_obclinic = dplyr::case_when(
      p_wald_obclinic < 5e-8 / 177 ~ "P < 2.8e-10: study-wide",
      p_wald_obclinic < 5e-8 ~ "P < 5e-8: genome-wide",
      TRUE ~ "P >= 5e-8: not significant"
    ),
    cis_trans = factor(
      cis_trans,
      levels = c("cis", "trans"),
      labels = c("Cis", "Trans")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cis_trans) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(beta_population, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_order = factor(y_label, levels = y_label)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

pqtl_sig_levels <- c(
  "P >= 5e-8: not significant",
  "P < 5e-8: genome-wide",
  "P < 2.8e-10: study-wide"
)
all_levels <- levels(comparison_het_plot$y_order)
x_range <- range(
  c(
    comparison_het_plot$beta_population - se_mult * comparison_het_plot$se_population,
    comparison_het_plot$beta_population + se_mult * comparison_het_plot$se_population,
    comparison_het_plot$beta_obclinic   - se_mult * comparison_het_plot$se_obclinic,
    comparison_het_plot$beta_obclinic   + se_mult * comparison_het_plot$se_obclinic
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

facet_label_df <- comparison_het_plot %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cis_trans, y_order) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cis_trans) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    y_top = all_levels[max(match(y_order, all_levels))]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_top  = factor(y_top, levels = all_levels),
    x_left = x_range[1] - 0.02,
    label  = as.character(cis_trans)
  )

p_new_forest <- ggplot(comparison_het_plot) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      x = beta_population,
      y = y_order,
      xmin = beta_population - se_mult * se_population,
      xmax = beta_population + se_mult * se_population,
      color = "Population",
      fill = dplyr::if_else(gw_population, "Population", "Not significant"),
      shape = pqtl_sig_population
    ),
    size = 0.4,
    fatten = point_size / 0.4,
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.05)
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      x = beta_obclinic,
      y = y_order,
      xmin = beta_obclinic - se_mult * se_obclinic,
      xmax = beta_obclinic + se_mult * se_obclinic,
      color = "Obesity clinic",
      fill = dplyr::if_else(gw_obclinic, "Obesity clinic", "Not significant"),
      shape = pqtl_sig_obclinic
    ),
    size = 0.4,
    fatten = point_size / 0.4,
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.05)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(comparison_het_plot, sw_population),
    aes(x = beta_population, y = y_order),
    shape = 21,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    size = study_border_size,
    stroke = 1,
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.05),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(comparison_het_plot, sw_obclinic),
    aes(x = beta_obclinic, y = y_order),
    shape = 21,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    size = study_border_size,
    stroke = 1,
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.05),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = facet_label_df,
    aes(x = x_left, y = y_top, label = label),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 4.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(cis_trans),
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    strip.position = "top"
  ) +
  ggh4x::force_panelsizes(rows = c(7, 19)) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "pQTL",
    limits = pqtl_sig_levels,
    values = c(
      "P >= 5e-8: not significant" = 21,
      "P < 5e-8: genome-wide" = 21,
      "P < 2.8e-10: study-wide" = 21
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "white",
      "Population" = color_population,
      "Obesity clinic" = color_obclinic
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Stratification",
    breaks = c("Population", "Obesity clinic"),
    values = c(
      "Population" = color_population,
      "Obesity clinic" = color_obclinic
    )
  ) +
  xlab("pQTL effect size (95% CI)") +
  ylab("Protein (pQTL)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "Stratification",
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        color = c(color_population, color_obclinic),
        fill = c(color_population, color_obclinic),
        size = legend_point_size,
        stroke = 0.7
      )
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      title = "pQTL significance",
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        color = c("grey", "grey", "black"),
        fill = c("white", "grey", "grey"),
        size = legend_point_size,
        stroke = c(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
      )
    )
  )

p_new_forest
ggsave(
  paste0(folder, "obesity_dependent_forest_plot.separate.png"),
  plot = p_new_forest,
  device = "png",
  width = 9,
  height = 8.4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
